note: v503: Budget audit. Ticking a bill paid recorded only THAT it was paid, never how much — so reconciliation fell back on the bill's planned amount. A variable bill (electric, water) could never match the real charge, and editing a recurring bill's amount quietly restated every occurrence you had ever paid, flipping months that already balanced back to needs-review. The paid flag now carries what actually left the bank, and the row shows it when it differs from the plan. Also: deleting a bill left its paid flags and its Paid-from tag behind, and the Budget report could only ever print the current month — it has a month picker now.
